input.summary:
Surulere Chill Store, Chiller shelf, audit confidence 0.93 (trustworthy, 100% planogram share, no unknown products). 5 of 10 planogram SKUs stocked out: Bigi Cola 60cl, Eva Water 75cl, Chivita Orange 1L, Five Alive Citrus 1L, Amstel Malta 33cl Can. The other 5 (Pepsi, Fanta, Sprite, Ragolis Water, Maltina) are at full expected facings.

Inventory check showed all five empty SKUs at or below their reorder point of 6, so I proposed one order each, in whole cases of 12, sized to reach expected_facings x 3 + reorder point:
- Bigi Cola 60cl: 24 units (on hand 0) - ₦6,000
- Eva Water 75cl: 24 units (on hand 2) - ₦4,800
- Amstel Malta 33cl Can: 24 units (on hand 1) - ₦10,800
- Chivita Orange 1L: 12 units (on hand 5) - ₦18,000
- Five Alive Citrus 1L: 12 units (on hand 5) - ₦16,800
Total approx. ₦56,400. Larger lines may be held for human review.

Important: four of the five empty slots have some back-room stock, so this is partly a shelf-refill problem, not only a supply problem. Chivita (5 units) and Five Alive (5 units) can be refilled to their full 3 facings immediately; Eva Water can fill 2 of 3 facings; Amstel Malta 1 facing. Only Bigi Cola has nothing to put out until delivery. A manager was notified on WhatsApp with this refill list.

No telemetry was available and nothing in the audit indicates equipment damage, so no technician was dispatched.
